title: Restoring a Backup for Zscaler Client Connector Settings

blocks.text: You can restore a backup of Zscaler Client Connector configuration settings that you created earlier. To learn more, see About Backup and Restore for Zscaler Client Connector.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Back Up and Restore > Client Connector.
Click Restore to restore the policies and configurations from the selected backup.

blocks.text: The policies and configuration settings from the selected backup overwrite the existing settings. You can view a record of the backup restore on the Restore tab.
